name: grill-with-docs
description: A document-grounded, adversarial design-review capability for ChatGPT. Grill a plan, proposal, design, strategy, or decision against the documents that bear on it: surface assumptions, contradictions, missing information, dependencies, risks, and silently assumed decisions, in rounds of questions with recommended answers.

interface.shortDescription: Stress-test a plan against your documents
interface.longDescription: An adversarial design-review facilitator that stress-tests a plan, proposal, or decision against the documents that bear on it, in rounds of numbered questions with recommended answers, and finishes with a synthesis of settled decisions, open risks, and the resulting plan.
defaultPrompt: Use $grill-with-docs to stress-test the plan or decision I describe, using the documents I attach as evidence.
Use $grill-with-docs to red-team the proposal I attach against the supporting documents, and end with a synthesis.
